properties.description: A shared reply helper that returns id, changed fields with sizes, edges drawn as sentences and warnings (removed text by size, prior text on request); a per-session registry of standing prose sent once then tagged; an all-or-nothing capture call for a requirement with its capability, links and author; column-form lists with field projection; and short tool descriptions with long guidance behind a help call — lessons still delivered at the call they concern.
properties.name: Write receipts, say-once standing guidance, capture bundles, compact list reads and short tool descriptions on reflow2's MCP surface
